name: Enoch Godongwana (Minister of Finance)
detail: Written replies to EFF questions (May and June 2025): the government is not considering a wealth tax; income tax is the most effective way to tax the wealthy and a wealth tax risks capital flight.

name: National Treasury
detail: Treasury's 2025 budget response argues a wealth tax would raise little and harm the income tax base; it has also said it is studying declared-wealth data, which is not a position for a tax.
